application_instructions_en: Apply through the Aurora office of your home university; the course page of the University of Duisburg-Essen (LSF) has the details.
Apply by e-mail to the course coordinator at the University of Duisburg-Essen (address on the course page), through the Aurora office of your home university.
Apply through the Aurora office of your home university, which nominates candidates to the host university by the application deadline; the host university confirms admission.
